feed.summary: Taiwan's National Communications Commission (NCC) is collaborating with major mobile operators to introduce voice alerts for hidden-number calls, a growing method used by scammers. Chunghwa Telecom will pilot a system starting March 2 that plays a warning message in Mandarin and Taiwanese before connecting a hidden-number call. This initiative aims to combat the 10% of scam calls now originating from hidden numbers, which primarily target mobile users.
feed.title: Taiwan telecoms tackle phone scams

This was accomplished using X-MIMO technology during an outdoor field test. The partners highlighted ultra-high-density antenna technology as a foundational component for 6G commercialization, paving the way for ultra-fast, immersive services.
feed.title: KT, Samsung push the 6G boundaries

feed.summary: Airgain, Inc. has secured a multi-year, multi-million-dollar design win for a next-generation 5G home connectivity platform with a major North American Mobile Network Operator. This win includes antenna systems for a 5G fixed wireless access router and a companion in-home Wi-Fi extender, reinforcing Airgain's position in high-volume consumer broadband. The company expects pre-production units to ship this quarter, with mass production anticipated later this year, leveraging its expertise in advanced multi-band antenna systems and comprehensive engineering services.
feed.title: Airgain Secures Multi‑Year, Multi‑Million Dollar Design Win for Tier‑1 MNO 5G Home Connectivity Platform

feed.summary: Niantic has launched the Planet-Scale AR Alliance, bringing together mobile industry leaders like Deutsche Telekom, EE, and Verizon to advance consumer augmented reality (AR) experiences on 5G networks. The alliance aims to create exclusive 5G-ready AR content and define new standards for AR innovation. This initiative will leverage Niantic's Real-World Platform with 5G capabilities such as low latency and edge computing to develop immersive, shared AR experiences.
feed.title: Introducing the Niantic Planet-Scale AR Alliance: Bringing the Mobile Industry Together Towards the 5G Future of Consumer AR

feed.summary: T-Mobile's plan to shut down its 3G CDMA network in January 2022 significantly impacts Boost Mobile, potentially affecting millions of customers and costing hundreds of millions of dollars for premature device upgrades. Boost Mobile, owned by Dish Network, had planned a slower migration of customers to T-Mobile's network, but the accelerated timeline requires substantial investment and could be considered anti-competitive. Dish and Boost Mobile are hoping for government intervention from the FCC or DoJ to address the issue and potentially provide more time or clarity.
feed.title: What T-Mobile 3G CDMA shutdown means for Boost Mobile

feed.summary: The Automotive Alliance, now named "Catena-X Automotive Network," is gaining momentum with new partners like Mercedes-Benz, BASF, and Henkel joining founding members BMW AG, Deutsche Telekom AG, Robert Bosch GmbH, SAP SE, Siemens AG, and ZF Friedrichshafen AG. This network aims to establish a uniform standard for data sharing across the automotive value chain to enhance competitiveness, improve efficiency, and accelerate processes, with a particular focus on enabling easy participation for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The initial pilot projects target quality management, logistics, maintenance, supply chain management, and sustainability, leveraging the International Data Spaces (IDS) standard.
feed.title: The alliance for secure and cross-company data exchange in the automotive industry is picking up speed

feed.summary: T-Mobile and Lumen have announced a partnership to combine T-Mobile's 5G mobile network with Lumen's edge computing infrastructure. This collaboration aims to provide enterprises with extended application capabilities, leveraging Lumen's extensive fiber network and data centers, and T-Mobile's leading 5G footprint. The deal strategically addresses the complementary strengths of both companies, with Lumen lacking a mobile business and T-Mobile lacking extensive wireline infrastructure, at a time when edge computing is crucial for low-latency 5G applications.
feed.title: Logical Partners: T-Mobile, Lumen Join Forces on 5G Edge Computing

feed.summary: Letitia "Tish" Long, a seasoned security and intelligence industry veteran and two-time Wash100 Award winner, has been appointed to the board of directors of T-Mobile US (Nasdaq: TMUS). In addition to joining the board, she will serve on the nominating and corporate governance committee and act as national security director, bolstering the company's commitments related to its merger with Sprint. Long's extensive background includes leadership roles at the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, Naval Intelligence, and the Defense Intelligence Agency.
feed.title: Letitia Long Named T-Mobile US Board Member, National Security Director

feed.summary: As 5G connectivity expands, 3G networks are being phased out by major carriers like AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile. This shutdown, expected by early 2022 for some, will impact older 3G phones and even some 4G devices without HD Voice, as well as connected devices like medical equipment and home security systems. Users are advised to check with their carrier to see if their devices are affected and may require software updates or upgrades to maintain service.
feed.title: Remember 3G? It's going away as AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile shift to 5G. What to know about 3G shutdown

feed.summary: T-Mobile US and Deutsche Telekom AG have launched T-IoT, a global solution designed to simplify IoT connectivity, platform management, and support for enterprises across 188 destinations. This offering aims to address the complexities businesses face in managing multinational IoT connections, such as fragmented agreements and varying payment models. T-IoT provides a single, flexible solution with worldwide network connectivity, a unified management interface, streamlined procurement, and adaptable pricing models.
feed.title: T-Mobile and Deutsche Telekom launch IoT solution to simplify connectivity for enterprises

feed.title: Apollo and Marcelo Claure looking at Latam Millicom takeover

This campaign highlights Charter's stance that FWA is an inferior technology compared to its own broadband offerings, particularly as fixed wireless providers gain subscribers.
feed.title: Charter Super Bowl ad takes a shot at T-Mobile Home Internet

feed.title: Stevens Capital Management LP Invests $6.35 Million in Verizon Communications Inc. $VZ

feed.summary: The Court of Appeal has dismissed an appeal against a Competition Appeal Tribunal (CAT) order mandating two defendant groups, Autoliv and ZF, to use a single joint expert for determining overcharge in a cartel claim. The decision emphasizes the Tribunal's paramount duty to restrict expert evidence to what is reasonably required for resolving the dispute justly and at proportionate cost. This ruling strengthens the CAT's ability to manage complex multi-defendant litigation, even when potential conflicts of interest among defendants are present.
feed.title: Stellantis Auto SAS v Autoliv AB [2024] EWCA Civ 609 – The Court of Appeal dismisses an appeal against an order of the Competition Appeal Tribunal requiring two defendant groups to use a single joint expert at trial in relation to the issue of overcharge

feed.summary: T-Mobile US, Inc. announced an ambitious three-year plan at its Capital Markets Day, focusing on extending network leadership, transforming customer experiences with AI, profitable market share gains in wireless and broadband, and growing new businesses. The company anticipates accelerating service revenue growth, a nearly $10 billion increase in annual Core Adjusted EBITDA by 2027, and industry-leading Adjusted Free Cash Flow. This strategy builds on T-Mobile's track record of exceeding past goals and aims to deliver significant value creation and stockholder returns.
feed.title: Fueled by Network Leadership and Transformative AI-Enabled Customer Experiences, T-Mobile Outlines Ambitious Plan for Continued Growth Leadership, Value Creation and Share Taking in Wireless and Broadband While Growing New Businesses

feed.summary: Elon Musk confirmed that Starlink's direct-to-mobile phone internet service will be exclusive to T-Mobile in the US for one year, after which it will open up to other carriers. The partnership, initially announced in 2022, aims to provide comprehensive mobile signal coverage, though rivals AT&T and Verizon have expressed concerns about potential harm to their networks.
feed.title: Elon Musk: T-Mobile to get exclusive access to Starlink for one year

The company plans to leverage its extensive fiber network as a foundation to enhance overall service quality for both fixed and mobile broadband users.
